name: fix_ts_implicit_any
description: Adds proper types to a module that fails tsc --strict with implicit any
prompts: cart.ts fails to compile under `tsc --strict` because every parameter is implicitly `any`. Add proper type annotations (an interface for the line items - objects with name: string, price: number, quantity: number - and typed parameters/returns) so it compiles cleanly under --strict. Do NOT change the runtime behavior: total(items, taxRate) still sums price*quantity and applies the tax rate rounded to 2 decimals, and describe(item) still returns the same template string.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit cart.ts 
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build cart.ts
node behavior_test.js
